meta.name: WarCommand — holotable skin on companion structure
meta.description: Visual DNA taken from holotable.net (style source, exact CSS tokens + measured screenshots) applied to helldiverscompanion.com's information architecture (layout source). Fonts are free substitutes for licensed faces.
source_references: https://holotable.net/#war (style: tokens read from :root --tb-* custom properties, 2026-10-23)

https://divershub.app/planets and /planets/fury (layout source for Hellpad › Planets and the planet detail only; its zinc palette and 12px radius are NOT adopted — rendered in this file's holotable tokens). Measurements: design/measurements/divershub-*.json

color.palette_type: near-black monochrome + four semantic faction hues + one hot CTA yellow

accent.role: CTA fill, focused/selected outline, 'IN PROGRESS' state, keycap highlight (--tb-cta)

neutral.usage: text-hi → text → text-dim → label → faint for type; line-strong/line for hairlines; surface-3..0 for panels; void #04070b behind everything. Light end is the foreground on the dark ground.

factions.map_region_stroke_note: Region contours render hotter than tokens: pink/magenta #ff5fa0-ish for automaton fronts and orange #ff8a3d for terminid fronts in the Regions overlay (screenshot-observed, glow-blended)

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast: near-white uppercase text on near-black; colour reserved for faction identity and state; color-mix() at fixed strengths (wash 8%, fill 14%, line 30%, edge 55%, solid 80%) derives every tint from one state colour

font_families.heading: Swiss 721 Extended (holotable) → substitute: Archivo variable at wdth 125, wght 700–800
font_families.body: FS Sinclair (holotable, licensed game font) → substitute: Chakra Petch 400/500/700 (already bundled via @fontsource)
font_families.mono: tabular-nums of the body face; no separate mono

typography.font_style_notes: Everything UPPERCASE with positive tracking that grows as size shrinks (8px gets 0.2em). Headings are wide-extended grotesk; body is a squared techno sans. Mixed-case only for long prose (briefings, dispatch bodies).
typography.license_note: FS Sinclair / Swiss 721 / HC Sinclair are commercial; do not copy font files from either site.

spacing.section_rhythm: panels pad 12px 14px; rows 6px 8px; chips 3px 8px; controls 7px 12px; 16–24px between panel groups

layout.grid_system: app shell: fixed top bar (52px) + ticker strip (~22px) + content + fixed bottom dock (~56px); content uses 2-column card grid (campaigns, news masonry) or 2-column split (overview)
layout.max_content_width: ~600px per card column, centered pair ≈ 560–620px; overview split 290px | 1fr
layout.alignment_tendency: centered content column inside full-bleed backdrop; HUD controls pinned to viewport edges on the map

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px hairlines (#33373f or rgba(255,255,255,.06)); 2px faction-coloured edge on selected/active; 3px rail for side accents
shape.divider_style: 1px hairline; section headers sit on a diagonal hazard-stripe band (repeating-linear-gradient 45deg, state colour 45% / transparent, 3px pitch)

elevation.shadow_style: layered: dark drop shadows + coloured glows from the state colour
elevation.depth_cues: blur/glass panels (backdrop blur 6–14px over the map) + colour-intensity glow + inset 1px top lip

iconography.style: solid filled pictograms in HUD boxes (skull emblem, gear, zoom, bars); faction emblems as filled glyphs
iconography.preferred_set: custom SVG faction emblems + Lucide for generic UI (never emoji glyphs)

motion.easing: out: cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1); pop: cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.25); glitch: steps(2,end)
motion.entrance_pattern: 60ms stagger reveal of panels; values count/tween over 320ms
motion.philosophy: functional with a heartbeat: 1.4s beat and 2.4s pulse on live markers, 9s ticker crawl, otherwise snappy; motion scaled by --tb-motion (0 for reduced motion)

components.button_style: square, 1px hairline, uppercase label; primary = solid #FFFF5A with near-black ink; HUD icon buttons 32–40px square boxes; keycap prefix chips ([ESC] CLOSE, [H] CONTROLS, [Q]/[E] tab cycling)
components.input_style: dark field, 1px line, uppercase placeholder; selectors as ◀ VALUE ▶ steppers with segmented underline showing position
components.card_style: surface-1 panel, hairline border, hatch-stripe header strip with icon box + title, faction 2px edge when tied to a planet; hover card = image header + kicker + yellow title + progress bar + footer hint
components.navigation_pattern: (holotable) top bar + hamburger; tab rows with Q/E keycaps; full-screen dossier overlays with ESC close
components.modal_style: full-viewport takeover on grid-paper backdrop, tabs top-left, ESC CLOSE bottom-left, primary action bottom-right
components.list_style: dense rows 6px 8px, planet dot + name + faction tag right-aligned in faction colour
components.component_notes: Meters: 7px block bars (3px inline) with tick gaps, faction-coloured, hatched remainder. Status chip: green 'FRONT' outlined tag + caps status line. Bottom-right stacked toggles (DISPATCHES n, EFFECTS n) with keycaps.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a Super Destroyer war-table hologram read off a military HUD
aesthetic.era_influence: near-future military FUI, game-UI lineage (Helldivers 2 in-game menus)

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents (hatch bands, corner brackets, keycaps, scanlines)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: tight; dark negative space does the separating
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: light chrome at the edges, colour and glow concentrated on data (planets, bars, fronts)
visual_language.focal_strategy: distributed interest anchored by one yellow element per view
visual_language.texture_usage: scanline overlay, faint grid paper behind overlays, dot-field territory fill

composition.balance_type: asymmetric (left title stack, right HUD rail)
composition.flow_direction: top-left title → centre data → bottom-right actions
composition.negative_space_role: the void is the galaxy; panels float on it

imagery.photo_treatment: game screenshots/biome art darkened with scrim gradient tinted by state colour
imagery.pattern_usage: hazard stripe on headers and remaining-progress; grid paper behind dossiers
imagery.image_shape: rectangles, square corners; planets as circles

interaction_feel.feedback_style: glow intensifies on hover/selection; yellow outline on focus
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: rich hover cards on map planets; hairline → faction edge on cards

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Super Earth military bureaucracy, deadpan satire
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative (JOIN THE FIGHT, SELECT CAMPAIGN, VIEW MAP)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: in-world status lines (NO ACTIVE DISPATCHES, LINK LOST · RETRYING)
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: in-world but clear (COMMS LINK DOWN — SHOWING LAST KNOWN DATA)

overview.fallback_strategy: quality presets: drop glow filters, dot field and ambient motion at Low; respect prefers-reduced-motion
overview.primary_technology: Canvas 2D (holotable uses stacked 2D canvases + WebGL2 for planet bodies); we keep SVG + d3-zoom and add a Canvas 2D starfield layer

background_effects.description: deep-space void with dense starfield, soft central core glow at Super Earth, faint polar grid rings

particle_systems.description: territory dot field: small dots tinted by controlling faction filling each region

params.movement_pattern: static, subtle shimmer on contested borders

3d_elements.description: holotable renders planet spheres in WebGL2 in the dossier; out of scope for v2 — use a radial-gradient sphere with biome tint

shader_effects.description: void plasma / environment sim on holotable; not reproduced

text_effects.description: glow text-shadow on state values (0 0 12px state@55%); ticker crawl

image_effects.description: scrim gradient (state colour 12% top → transparent → rgba(6,8,12,.9) bottom) + optional scanline over planet art

canvas_drawings.description: galaxy map: smoothed faction region contours, constellation supply lanes, glowing star planets, campaign flags with LIBERATE/DEFEND tags

params.draw_method: smoothed contour of merged same-owner cells, thick neon stroke + blur glow, ~5% fill
params.animation_loop: requestAnimationFrame only for twinkle/pulse, paused when hidden
params.interaction: pan, zoom, hover card, click → dossier

svg_animations.description: pulse rings on active campaigns, beat on MO targets

visual_effects.composite_notes: Holotable stacks: static canvas (stars, regions) + dynamic canvas (pulses) + UI canvas (labels) + WebGL bodies. We reproduce the read of it in SVG+Canvas2D: backdrop canvas, SVG regions/lanes/planets, HTML HUD. Companion structure (cards, overview charts, news masonry) gets holotable's panels, hatch headers, meters and glows; the companion's own yellow-black HD2 chrome and CRT-blue Hellpad are NOT carried over.
